mapper.select: select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Other_Valuation as secOtherValuation, sec.Sec_Pricing_Method as secPricingMethod, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, c1.C_Name as erCandidateName, c1.C_Abbreviation as erCandiAbbName, er.* from Sec_Eval_Report er left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=er.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on er.Er_Candidate_Unit=c1.C_Id where er.Er_Id=#{erId}

select sed.erd_Id as erdId, sed.Er_Id as erId, sed.C_Id as cId, c1.C_Name as cName, sed.Erd_Price_And_Rate as erdPriceAndRate, sed.Erd_Sort as erdSort, sed.Erd_Price as erdPrice, sed.Erd_Rate as erdRate from Sec_Eval_Report_Dtl sed left join SYS_Company c1 on sed.C_Id=c1.C_Id where sed.er_Id=#{erId}

select ${selectClause} from Sec_Eval_Report mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join pre_project pre on pre.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Department sd on pre.P_Competent_Department = sd.D_Id left join Sec_Bidding_Plan sbp on sbp.Bp_Id=sec.Bp_Id left join ( select sp1.Sec_Id, sp1.P_ID, pro1.P_Name, pro1.p_Category, pro1.P_Build_Model, dpre1.D_Name from Sec_Project sp1 inner join pre_project pro1 on pro1.P_Id = sp1.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre1 on dpre1.D_Id = pro1.p_Competent_Department where not exists ( select 1 from Sec_Project sp2 inner join pre_project pro2 on pro2.P_Id = sp2.P_Id where sp2.Sec_Id = sp1.Sec_Id and pro2.P_Create_Time > pro1.P_Create_Time )) sp on sp.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id
